definitions: A person who is currently the heir but whose position could be displaced by the birth of a more closely related heir.
The person who would inherit a title or property if the present holder were to die, but whose claim can be defeated by the birth of a nearer heir.
examples: The princess was the heir presumptive until her brother was born.
The duke's nephew was the heir presumptive for many years.
The birth of a new child changed the status of the heir presumptive.
